verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a payments protocol and developer platform like x402, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only an SDK, an npm package, a Bazaar MCP server, a generated OpenAPI client and an llms.txt index; none of it shows an official command-line tool. These are building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
